# CODE_INDEX.md — generated navigation map for zm_qol

**Generated by `handoff/gen_index.py`. Do not hand-edit — regenerate it.**

Every entry is `file:line`. Open a window at the offset instead of reading the
whole file. `quality_of_life.gsc` alone is 15,743 lines; reading it to find one
function is the most expensive habit in this project and it is paid out of a
metered Pro window.

Regenerate after any change that moves functions:

```
python handoff\gen_index.py
```
